name: Aota Miki
source:
A classmate of Ryotaro.
She’s kind to everyone and has a friendly demeanor, but she’s a plain, unremarkable “background character” type of girl.
She’s easily swayed and can’t say no when asked for a favor.
Her sex drive is average, but she’s extremely sensitive.
She’s surprisingly talkative.

“Ugh… You didn’t even remember my name? That’s actually kind of a shock.”

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ015599.html/]dlsite[/url]]
